messages:
ana: Heads-up: a mentoring workshop attendee hit a confusing error during the Node quickstart. They used json_mode with a toy tool and schema validation failed.

jin: What error did they see?

ana: The error was `schema error: expected object but got string`. The quickstart shows the tool output as `\"{}\"` in logs. Python quickstart returns {} for same stub.

robert: Hmm, not the usual double-stringify token we've seen, looks like an outer quoting step somewhere. Which SDK + quickstart versions?

ana: quickstarts@2026-03 (fresh), node-sdk@0.8.0 used by the workshop. Repro: stub tool returns 204 no-content. Node client prints \"{}\" whereas python prints {}.

jin: That matches a subtle ordering bug: stream-assembler emits buffer chunks as strings, then normalizeToolOutput does a `String(buf)` and later a `JSON.stringify` guard for safety. If a retry interceptor also stringifies the captured body for logs, you can end up with an extra quoted layer.

robert: We haven't seen this exact workshop hit before because most quickstarts did a post-coerce step in samples, but the new workshop used the raw SDK example.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-6120: "node quickstart: quoted-empty tool output in json_mode" (assignee: jin).

sara: Short-term mitigation: update workshop notes to show a tiny helper snippet that coerces string payloads into parsed JSON (try JSON.parse and fallback to {}), and mention pinning node-sdk to 0.8.1 once we cut the patch.

ana: Can we get a small patch out? The workshop cohort has ~30 students and this blocks several of them.

jin: Plan: 1) add a guard in normalizeToolOutput to detect one-level-quoted JSON strings and unquote them before final parse, 2) audit retry/auth interceptors for stray JSON.stringify calls that run on response capture, 3) add an integration test in sample-quickstarts that runs node+py examples with a stubbed tool returning 204 and asserts normalization parity. I'll open PR tonight.

robert: Also add a unit test for streaming chunk assembly path where chunks are Buffers vs Strings. That was the really flaky branch.

devex-bot: DEVEX-6120 status: triaged (assignee: jin).

jin: Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/2522 1: fixed normalizeToolOutput + tests. Cutting v0.8.1 patch after CI.

ci-bot: CI shows the new parity e2e failing on flaky network in sample-quickstarts. Filing follow-up to stabilize test harness.

ana: Verified with local build of v0.8.1 branch: workshop examples no longer hit schema error; tool output normalized to {}. Marking workshop guide updated.

robert: I'll follow up to ensure the retry-layer audit lands; if anyone sees similar quoted array artifacts ("[\"\"]") open DEVEX-6121 and assign to me.

jena: Thanks all 1; leaving a note in the onboarding checklist to bump quickstarts to node-sdk v0.8.1 for the next run.
